prompt: Some people believe that young children should learn to use computers as early as possible. Others think it is better for children to spend their time on traditional activities, such as playing outside. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
These days, computers and tablets are a normal part of daily life. Some people think young children should start using them early, while others believe children should spend more time on activities like sports and outdoor games. In my opinion, both are important, but children need a good balance between them.

On the one hand, there are good reasons to introduce computers at an early age. First, most jobs today need basic computer skills, so children who learn them young will feel more confident in the future. In addition, there are many educational apps and games that make learning fun, for example apps that teach maths or new languages. As a result, children can learn faster and enjoy school more. Parents can also guide them, so the time they spend on the screen is useful.

On the other hand, traditional activities are very important for children's health and development. Playing football or riding a bike keeps the body strong and helps prevent problems such as obesity. Too much screen time can also hurt their eyes and their sleep. Moreover, when children play with other kids, they learn how to share, make friends and solve problems together. For instance, a child who spends hours alone on a tablet may find it difficult to talk to classmates at school.

In conclusion, computers can be very useful for learning, but outdoor activities are necessary for health and social skills. I believe parents should limit screen time and make sure their children do both
